about: A real run of this preset, recorded from the Gemini API by tests/record.mjs. Every reply is the model's text as it came back. Practice mode replays it when the team and task match exactly.
task: Write a flyer for ExplorAI's board game night: this Friday, 5 to 7 pm, in CIS A-204. Beginners welcome, all games provided, bring a friend.

messages.text: Write a flyer for ExplorAI's board game night: this Friday, 5 to 7 pm, in CIS A-204. Beginners welcome, all games provided, bring a friend.

🎲 **LEVEL UP YOUR FRIDAY NIGHT!** 🎲

Join us for the ultimate **ExplorAI Board Game Night**! Whether you're a seasoned strategist or have never rolled a 20-sided die in your life, come hang out, unwind, and play some games with us.

📅 **When:** This Friday  
⏰ **Time:** 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM  
📍 **Where:** CIS A-204  

**Why you should drop by:**
* 🧠 **Beginners Welcome!** We’ll teach you the rules—no prior experience needed.
* 📦 **All Games Provided!** Just bring yourself (though your favorite game is always welcome too).
* 👥 **Bring a Friend!** The more, the merrier. 

Grab a snack, grab a seat, and let the games begin. See you there!
